additional_info.subject: 0473159 - ID0473159-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R3 312881977006] CONVERTER_GROUPING isn't possible CRM:00314000256
additional_info.body:
Good morning Furkan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0473159.
I took a look at the charger this morning, and found several issues with the configuration of the charger. This was the error flag scenario reported:
It is already visible that there is a PLC configuration incompatibility.
I checked the PLC configuration, and saw that DC was not configured in terms of cable type:
Once this error was cleared, the outlets were still unavailable with the following errors:
I checked the outlet configuration and LEMs were configured, while according to the circuit diagram this charger has no LEMs.
Once I corrected these configuration issues, I took a look at the converter grouping via the debug station
The charger has one converter in DC1 which is only slightly raising the voltage during converter grouping and then it is decreasing very slowly. Therefore, the current configuration of the charger is: DC1: 1 converter (instead of 2 installed/configured), DC2: 2 converters, DC3 and DC4: 1 converter configured and installed.
In my eyes, it necessary to go onsite and replace the converter with SN:
2102312VGQKXNB000713
Currently, the charger is configured correctly, outlets are available, and the only error flag active is on the missing power converter.
I recommend to go onsite and replace the power converter, as well as to use the circuit diagram as reference when configuring the charger on SCB.
Therefore, I am moving the case
0473159
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
